scope: 72 unchanged ordinary consumable player-transport primary assignments; existing tags retained and supplemental roles unassessed.
reviewedPrimaryRule: Own exact numeric-ID non-equipment stackable item has an active Break, Teleport, Launch or Squash action and its full named-subject definition directly establishes consumable player transport. Ordinary quest/destination requirements and minigame acquisition do not imply an activity-only copy. Equipment, unlock tokens, modifiers and items that move another object are outside this exact cohort.
reviewRecord: Root read all 72 literal own-subject leads and exact active options, then examined competing use, quest/access and creation contexts from the pinned source articles. All 48 tablets, 20 scrolls and 4 other consumables support their existing primary route. The separate exact-state adversarial review found no confirmed exceptions. Teleport to boat 31443 transports the player to their boat, while Summon boat 31441 moves the boat and is outside the cohort. Grand seed pod 9469 Farming effects remain unassessed secondary roles. Plain of Mud sphere 26577 is repeat-use player transport obtainable after its quest. No unconditional access, bankability, numerical effect, tag or exhaustive secondary-role claim is approved.

cases.title: Grand seed pod
cases.semanticExcerpt:
'''grand seed pod''' is a single-use teleport item that can be obtained as a rare reward from [[Wingstone]], [[Penwie]], [[Brambickle]], and [[Professor Manglethorp]] in the [[Gnome Restaurant]] [[minigame]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/jagexash/status/601448169273065472|date=21 May 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/108384|archivedate=29 May 2020|quote=Wingstone gives a mint cake or 5 seed pods, each with a 1/4 chance.}}{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/646787678583681024|date=23 September 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98418|archivedate=29 May 2020|quote=1/22, but only from Manglethorp and the three exploring gnomes.}} Seed pods are stackable. They can take players to the [[Grand Tree]], and have two right-click options: launch and squash.
[[File:Squash Grand seed pod.gif|left|thumb|130px|A player squashing the seed pod.]]
[[File:Launch Grand seed pod.gif|left|thumb|130px|A player launching the seed pod.]]
Launching the seed pod will take players to the top floor of the [[Grand Tree]], through [[Captain Lamdoo]] and a glider, but it can only be used outdoors. This option will also give the player 100 [[Farming]] experience. Squashing the seed will take players to the Grand Tree (to the ground floor by [[King Narnode Shareen]]) faster than Launching it, but the Farming experience will not be given, and will temporarily drain their Farming skill by 5 levels.
cases.rationale: The exact own active non-equipment consumable moves the player to a destination, with source-defined requirements preserved. Its unchanged Teleport primary grouping is supported. Documented secondary uses and effects remain unassessed.
